d:
A jellyfish-like entity with a translucent, milky-white bell-shaped head and long, flowing tentacles of pale cream. The eyes are small, dark, and beady, set deep into the translucent skull. The body consists of a singular, large, translucent white bell with multiple trailing, slender tentacles of the same pale hue. It possesses no fingers or claws.
BODY COLOR: milky-white
